{{Top}}
'''Uvide''' was a [[Gambling/Legends|gambler's]] game of chance made popular in many high-end [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The focus of the game required players to bet on a number-specific outcome determined by a croupier spinning a pocketed device known as the ''uvide wheel''.

There was a [[gaming parlor]] on the ''[[Queen of Empire]]'' where passengers could play uvide.

==Behind the scenes==
The game of uvide bore many similarities to the Earth-based casino game known as ''roulette''.
